verdict.rationale: Greptile has a confirmed llms.txt at the root (HTTP 200) plus per-page .md variants (e.g. docs/introduction.md) and a documentation index at docs/llms.txt, explicitly designed for agents to fetch; docs also explicitly invite handing pages to a coding agent to run setup. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that an external agent successfully consumed llms.txt end-to-end, and no evidence of an OpenAPI spec to complement it.
